$comment: Traceability: explicit rejection is always a frame, never silence (worker-service-seam.md §1). Unknown protocol versions are rejected with unsupported_protocol_version, never silently accepted.

msg_type.description: Wire discriminator: names the message type. Added in the Phase 1 edit (2026-09-18); the Phase 0 schemas pinned no discriminator, and service.error already used "message" for human-readable text, so routing on "message" was impossible.

in_reply_to.description: Present when the error answers a specific worker message.

max_supported_protocol.description: Present with unsupported_protocol_version: the highest version this service speaks.

message.description: Operator-facing reason. Never includes provider internals or secrets.

title: service.error
